title: An item parked on a human request is shown as waiting on that request, and no longer holds a pipeline slot
description: A fixture install at concurrency 2 holds item A parked on a human request with no blocker, item B released and depending on A, and item C independent in the backlog. The loop's cycle releases and launches C; master status shows A waiting on the request (never 'a launch is requested'), lists the request once in attention with its age, marked overdue past an hour, and the exact answer command; answering the request makes A dispatchable at once.

steps.name: a parked item waits on its request, holds no slot, and the independent item is released and launched
